items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did Colors at Banff the same week I did Stowell and Don Thompson... Here’s another record I like a lot, that you did at Banff with John Stowell and Don Thompson.

ctx.x: Here’s one with a Canadian band, with Don Thompson and Claude Ranger, plus Steve LaSpina on bass.

The legendary Claude Ranger, who’s disappeared. This is Don Thompson recording and playing at the same time. Hitting the microphone and coming into the studio. It is his label called From Bebop to Now.
